proposals.evidence: The fifth *ḍēvva branch explicitly gives Oriya ḍebarā/ḍebiri and Bengali ḍebrā left-handed, alongside Nepali ḍebre left. These retroflex-ḍ eastern survey ḍeb-/ḍebr- forms match that branch, with the local feminine/adjectival final i. Dental-d forms are kept on Turner’s separate eighth branch.

proposals.evidence: Turner separates dental *dēvva, with Nepali debre and Hindi debrā left, from retroflex *ḍēvva. These survey dental-d debr- forms fit the eighth branch; vowel length and the final adjectival vowel vary locally. Forms with initial l/n, a different stem vowel, or an additional word are not silently collapsed into this set.
